purpose: Aggregate, non-sensitive summary of the controlled multi-hazard source acquisition and QA run. Raw source files are not committed to Git; this record is not a scientific validation certificate.

acquisition.retention_note: Private short-lived workflow artifact. Re-run the existing acquisition workflow to reproduce after expiry; do not treat the artifact as a permanent data store.

limitations: Source timezone is not established; timestamps remain timezone-naive.
Stations have irregular intervals and substantial long gaps.
Ernakulam district coverage is not equivalent to Kochi Corporation coverage.
Rainfall observations are not verified flood/no-flood outcome labels.
Vertical gauge datum/reference and source timezone remain unresolved.
Provider-reported river/basin labels and station identities require review.
River stage is not flood depth; no threshold comparison or flood prediction is enabled.
No records are source-labelled Ernakulam in this download.
Gauge reference, timezone, sampling gaps and some river/basin labels remain unresolved.
District/event mentions are not station-hour labels or ward-level inundation evidence.
The dataset landing page did not clearly establish the applicable licence for redistribution.
Missing dates and impact fields require source-specific treatment.
District-scale summaries cannot be assigned to individual Kochi wards or hours.
Definitions, units, reference periods and missingness require review.
All 26 Kerala gauge metadata records are marked Privacy=Open in the acquired source; do not generalize this to the other 188 gauges, 59 of which are Restricted.
Candidate Periyar/Muvattupuzha gauges have historical event records, but their identities and coordinates have not been crosswalked to Kerala Surface Water/NWDP stations.
The INDOFLOODS event records end in 2020, while the newly acquired Kerala Surface Water telemetry begins in 2021; these datasets do not directly overlap in time.
A defensible flood probability model still needs event/no-event windows, verified gauge-specific thresholds, matched rainfall windows, missingness controls and leakage-free validation.
District/event mentions do not establish ward-level or station-hour flood outcomes.
datasets.kerala_privacy_screen: All 26 Kerala gauge records in this metadata join have Privacy=Open; other states contain restricted gauge records that must not be used in shareable derivatives.

datasets.acquisition_status: downloaded_raw_unvalidated; manifest counts matched; descriptive audit completed; not validated for impact prediction

kochi_proximity_screening.interpretation: Distance screening only; not municipal-boundary intersection, landfall, wind footprint, rainfall, surge, damage or probability of consequences.

limitations: The original IMD workbook was not downloaded by this workflow; its SHA-256 is reported by the parser mirror and was not independently recomputed against the workbook.
32 rows participate in duplicate storm/time pairs; 203 fixes carry a date-suspect flag and 2 carry a position-suspect flag. These are not corrected or dropped.
Fourteen rows lack coordinates; no coordinates are out of range.
The mirror parser repository is BSD-3-Clause, but underlying IMD data are © IMD and terms for redistribution/operational use remain to be confirmed.
Track-to-point distance does not estimate wind damage, rainfall, storm surge, flood impact, or exposure.

datasets.acquisition_status: downloaded_raw; 12 non-overlapping time windows queried; audit completed; not validated for local ground shaking

kochi_proximity_screening.interpretation: Regional event proximity only. Absence of events within 300 km in this catalogue/query does not mean zero local seismic hazard.

limitations: USGS ComCat is a multi-network catalogue; completeness and location uncertainty vary by time, magnitude and contributing network.
The query excludes events below magnitude 2.5 and is not a complete India-specific catalogue.
No events within 300 km is a query result, not evidence of no hazard.
Magnitude, depth and epicentre distance do not alone predict shaking or damage in Kochi.
Compare with NCS and GSI seismotectonic evidence; obtain site geology, local ground-motion models, building inventory and vulnerability data before consequence analysis.
